text:
Mira (Support): quick heads-up — Acme Corp says a Private deployment promo ended up on their hosted team instead of their Private tenant. Tenant ID: tenant-acme-42. Promo code: PRIVATE-ENT-100, issued by sales for a trial.

auto-voucher-bot: Voucher applied: PRIVATE-ENT-100 -> account: acme-hosted-team-7 (id:vchr_20260405_8321)

Eunice (Billing): can you paste the full voucher id and any ledger refs? I'll look up the invoice side.

Mira (Support): voucher id is vchr_20260405_8321. UI shows scope=hosted, sku=hosted-pro. Expected: scope=private, sku=private-enterprise.

Jonah P.: probable cause — onboarding flow defaulted to hosted because the "environment" flag was omitted. We can reassign vouchers but need owner consent + an audit record. Process: 1) confirm tenant contact 2) run internal reassign CLI 3) update ledger.

Sam (InfraOps): I can do the reassign once we have tenant + voucher id. It creates an audit entry. Command I will run: 

```
voucher-reassign --voucher vchr_20260405_8321 --from-account acme-hosted-team-7 --to-tenant tenant-acme-42 --reason "sales trial misapplied"
```

Mira (Support): Customer rep confirmed consent (Sara, sara@acme.com). They asked: will this cause any downtime or change to their quotas?

Eunice (Billing): No downtime. Reassign marks the voucher as moved and triggers a ledger correction / credit memo. Usage against Private SKU starts after assignment. I'll create a credit memo once the reassign completes.

Jonah P.: also check quotas — Private uses reserved-capacity SKU, so we'll need to attach the voucher to their private SKU row. Sam, can you verify if tenant has a private SKU entry?

Sam (InfraOps): tenant-acme-42 currently has no private SKU entry. After reassign I will attach private-enterprise-sku and kick provisioning. ETA ~30 minutes.

Mira (Support): Copy of customer's written consent: "Acme (Sara) approves reassignment of PRIVATE-ENT-100 to tenant-acme-42." Proceed when ready.

Sam (InfraOps): running now... :hammer_and_wrench:

auto-voucher-bot: Reassign completed: vchr_20260405_8321 moved to tenant-acme-42 by Sam (InfraOps). Audit: audit_98765

Eunice (Billing): Ledger updated, created credit memo CM-5543 and adjusted hosted-account charges. Finance notified.

Mira (Support): :thumbsup: I'll close the loop with Acme and confirm they see the Private credits in their console. Thanks everyone for the quick turn.
